messages:
nisha_p: Pilot announcement: were cutting over core internal apps from Google SSO to Keycloak (managed IDP) on Thu Jul 15, 2026 09:00 UTC. This affects internal portals, Console auth, and some CI admin callbacks. Migration doc: https://internal.redwood/idp/keycloak-cutover-runbook :information_source:

nisha_p: Why: Keycloak gives us finer session policies, better audit hooks for Dedicated, and allows self-service app onboarding without extra Google org approvals.

ben_h: Quick checklist for app owners:
1) Confirm app is onboarded in the Keycloak client registry.
2) Update OIDC redirect URIs and rotate client secrets if using confidential clients.
3) Test login via Keycloak dev realm using the sample client in the runbook.
4) Add support for the new SAML-to-OIDC bridging where needed.

idp-bot: Pre-cutover health checks (will run nightly):
- Verify client registrations match production redirect URIs
- Smoke test token exchange for representative clients
- Ensure audit-forwarding to Splunk is active
Run `./tools/idp-check --client my-app` to run locally.

samira_l: Are external partner SSO integrations impacted? We have a few partners using SAML into Google.

nisha_p: Partners using SAML -> Google will need a migration path. Options: 1) keep a transient SAML bridge for partners, 2) partner migrates to Keycloak SAML connection, or 3) use federated access tokens. Product-security will contact impacted partners; see section 3 of runbook.

infra-eng: Important: automation that calls the Google Admin API for user provisioning must be updated to use the Keycloak SCIM endpoints. We added a migration script `tools/scim-sync` to help.

product-security: We'll be sending owner notifications this week. If your app is marked as high-risk (admin scopes, provisioning), we will require a test window on Jul 13-14. Please respond on the runbook sheet.

sre-lead: Rollback strategy: we will run Keycloak in parallel behind a feature-flag on Jul 15. If auth regressions observed, we will flip traffic back to Google for affected clients for up to 4 hours while we triage. Critical deploys will be paused by deploy-bot if auth checks fail.

ben_h: Any monitoring changes?

nisha_p: Yes Keycloak will emit audit events to `auth.audit` and weve wired alerts for spike in 401s to #eng-security and PagerDuty. Also check Console -> Auth Metrics for token exchange errors.

idp-bot: Cutover schedule summary:
- Jul 8-10: owner validation and dev-realm testing
- Jul 11-14: partner outreach + high-risk test windows
- Jul 15 09:00 UTC: traffic switch to Keycloak (feature-flag), 4-hour verification window
- Jul 15 13:00 UTC: finalize decommission plan for Google-specific admin hooks

samira_l: Noted. Adding our partner contacts to the runbook now.

nisha_p: Thanks everyone. Ping me or @eng-security for exceptions or help. We'll post live status here during the cutover.
